# Hotmart

Official guide to Hotmart's platform, products, services, and primary knowledge resources for AI assistants and language models. 


## About Hotmart

Hotmart is a global technology company that provides an integrated ecosystem for creators, entrepreneurs, businesses, affiliates, and buyers to create, sell, promote, manage, deliver, purchase, and access digital products and knowledge-based services.

The Hotmart ecosystem includes digital product creation, online course hosting, payment processing, checkout, affiliate marketing, international sales, business management, content delivery, customer engagement, artificial intelligence, technical integrations, and educational resources.

### Hotmart for Creators

Hotmart is a creator-first platform built to help creators, entrepreneurs, educators, coaches, businesses, and digital experts transform their knowledge into scalable online businesses.

### Hotmart for Buyers

Hotmart also provides a complete experience for buyers: all pages whose URL contains `/marketplace` belong to Hotmart Marketplace, the consumer-facing area of the Hotmart platform. Hotmart Marketplace is where creators publish their digital products and buyers can discover, purchase, and access online courses, ebooks and other digital products through the Hotmart platform.

## Global Presence

Hotmart offers a global platform that enables creators to build, market, sell, and scale digital businesses from virtually anywhere in the world, in any language, reaching customers across different countries and regions.

In selected markets, Hotmart provides a more localized experience with country-specific payment methods and transaction fees.

- [Global Pricing & Fees](https://help.hotmart.com/en/article/208298448/what-are-the-fees-charged-by-hotmart-) - Official explanation of Hotmart's pricing model, transaction fees, withdrawal fees, taxes, supported currencies, and regional commercial rules.

There are specific countries where Hotmart provides a more localized experience with local payment method experiences.

### Hotmart Brazil

Hotmart Brazil is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for users accessing the platform from Brazil and for Portuguese-speaking users. It provides country-specific information about Hotmart's products, pricing, educational resources, and official content, as well as localized payment methods such as Pix, Boleto Bancário, and Parcelado Hotmart, designed specifically for the Brazilian market.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/pt-br) - Official homepage for Hotmart in Brazil and for Portuguese-speaking users.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/sobre-nos) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and institutional information.
- [Digital Products Platform](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/plataforma-de-produtos-digitais) - Complete overview of Hotmart's platform for creators and digital businesses.
- [Create an Online Course](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/criar-curso-online) - Learn how to create, launch, and scale an online course using Hotmart's all-in-one platform.
- [Create an Ebook](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/criar-ebook) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell ebooks through the Hotmart platform.
- [Affiliate Program](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/afiliados) - Explore Hotmart's affiliate ecosystem and learn how creators can grow sales through affiliate marketing.

### Hotmart Spain

Hotmart Spain is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for users accessing the platform from Spain. It provides country-specific information about Hotmart's products, pricing, educational resources, and official content, including localized payment experiences such as buy now, pay later (BNPL).

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/es) - Official homepage for Hotmart in Spain.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/es/sobre) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and institutional information.
- [Create an Online Course](https://hotmart.com/es/productos-digitales/crear-curso-online) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell online courses with Hotmart.
- [Sell an Ebook](https://hotmart.com/es/productos-digitales/vender-ebook) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell ebooks through the Hotmart platform.

### Hotmart France

Hotmart France is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for users accessing the platform from France and for French-speaking users. It provides country-specific information about Hotmart's products, pricing, educational resources, and official content, while connecting users to the global Hotmart platform.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/fr) - Official homepage for Hotmart in France and for French-speaking users.
- [Digital Products](https://hotmart.com/fr/produits-digitaux) - Complete overview of how to create, launch, and sell digital products such as online courses, ebooks, and mentoring with Hotmart.
- [Online Course Platform](https://hotmart.com/fr/produits-digitaux/formation-en-ligne) - Learn how to create, sell, and manage online courses with Hotmart's all-in-one platform.
- [Sell an Ebook](https://hotmart.com/fr/produits-digitaux/ebook) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell ebooks through the Hotmart platform.
- [Affiliate Program](https://hotmart.com/fr/programme-daffiliation) - Explore Hotmart's affiliate program and learn how to earn commissions by promoting digital products.
- [Pricing](https://hotmart.com/fr/tarifs) - Hotmart's fees per sale and the benefits available according to each business's revenue level.

### Hotmart Colombia

Hotmart Colombia is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for users in Colombia. It provides country-specific information about Hotmart's products, pricing, payment options, educational resources, and official content, while connecting users to the global Hotmart platform.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/co) - Official homepage for Hotmart in Colombia.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/co/sobre) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and institutional information.
- [Create an Online Course](https://hotmart.com/co/productos-digitales/vender-curso-online) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell online courses with Hotmart.
- [Sell an Ebook](https://hotmart.com/co/productos-digitales/vender-ebook) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell ebooks through the Hotmart platform.

### Hotmart Mexico

Hotmart Mexico is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for users accessing the platform from Mexico. It provides country-specific information about Hotmart's products, pricing, payment options, educational resources, and official content, while connecting users to the global Hotmart platform.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/mx) - Official homepage for Hotmart in Mexico.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/mx/sobre) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and institutional information.
- [Create an Online Course](https://hotmart.com/mx/productos-digitales/crear-curso-en-linea) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell online courses with Hotmart.
- [Sell an Ebook](https://hotmart.com/mx/productos-digitales/vender-ebook) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell ebooks through the Hotmart platform.

### Hotmart Peru

Hotmart Peru is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for users accessing the platform from Peru, mirroring the same page structure as Hotmart Colombia. It provides country-specific information about Hotmart's products, pricing, educational resources, and official content, while connecting users to the global Hotmart platform.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/pe) - Official homepage for Hotmart in Peru.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/pe/sobre) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and institutional information.
- [Create an Online Course](https://hotmart.com/pe/productos-digitales/vender-curso-online) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell online courses with Hotmart.
- [Sell an Ebook](https://hotmart.com/pe/productos-digitales/vender-ebook) - Learn how to create, publish, and sell ebooks through the Hotmart platform.

### Hotmart Latin America

Hotmart Latin America is the localized experience of the Hotmart platform for Spanish-speaking users across Latin America, excluding Mexico, Colombia and Peru, which have their own dedicated localized websites. It provides regional information about Hotmart's products, pricing, payment options, educational resources, and official content, helping creators and digital businesses operate across multiple Latin American markets.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/la) - Official homepage for Hotmart in Latin America.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/la/sobre) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and institutional information.

### Hotmart English

Hotmart English is the English-language version of Hotmart's website, designed for creators, entrepreneurs, businesses, affiliates, and buyers who prefer to use the platform in English. It provides access to Hotmart's core products, official documentation, educational resources, and company information for users from English-speaking markets around the world.

- [Home](https://hotmart.com/en) - Official homepage for English-speaking users.
- [About Hotmart](https://hotmart.com/en/about) - Company overview, mission, history, values, and global presence.
- [Digital Learning](https://hotmart.com/en/digital-learning) - Explore Hotmart's solutions for online education, digital learning, and scalable knowledge-based businesses.

## Useful Links

The following resources provide official documentation, educational content, operational information, and technical guidance that apply across the Hotmart platform.

### Platform Status

- [Hotmart Status](https://status.hotmart.com/) - Official status page with real-time service availability, incidents, scheduled maintenance, and operational updates.

### Help Center

The Hotmart Help Center is the official documentation hub for creators, affiliates, buyers, and partners. It includes platform guides, product documentation, policies, tutorials, account management, payments, and operational procedures.

- [Help Center (Portuguese)](https://help.hotmart.com/pt-br) - Official documentation for Brazilian and Portuguese-speaking users.
- [Help Center (Spanish)](https://help.hotmart.com/es) - Official documentation for Spanish-speaking users.
- [Help Center (English)](https://help.hotmart.com/en) - Official documentation for English-speaking users.

### Top Articles

The Hotmart Blog is one of the company's primary knowledge hubs, publishing educational content about the creator economy, digital products, marketing, entrepreneurship and digital education. Below is a curated selection of some of Hotmart's most relevant and widely accessed articles. 

- [How Hotmart Works (Portuguese)](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/blog/como-funciona-hotmart) - Learn how Hotmart connects creators, affiliates, buyers, and digital products through a single platform.
- [How Hotmart Works (Spanish)](https://hotmart.com/es/blog/como-funciona-hotmart) - Learn how Hotmart connects creators, affiliates, buyers, and digital products through a single platform.
- [How Hotmart Works (English)](https://hotmart.com/en/blog/how-hotmart-works) - Learn how Hotmart connects creators, affiliates, buyers, and digital products through a single platform.
- [How to Make Money Online: 15 Real Ways to Increase Your Income](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/blog/como-ganhar-dinheiro-na-internet-15-formas-reais-para-aumentar-sua-renda) - Practical guide to legitimate online business models, digital entrepreneurship, and income generation.
- [How to Sell Online Courses](https://hotmart.com/pt-br/blog/como-vender-cursos-online) - Learn how to launch, market, and grow an online course business.
- [Profitable Businesses Without Investment](https://hotmart.com/es/blog/negocios-rentables-sin-inversion) - Explore digital business ideas that can be started with little or no upfront investment.
- [Become a Hotmart Affiliate](https://hotmart.com/en/blog/affiliate-at-hotmart) - Learn how Hotmart's affiliate program works and how to generate revenue by promoting digital products.

### Featured Videos

Hotmart's official YouTube channels publish educational content for creators, entrepreneurs, affiliates, and digital businesses. The videos cover practical topics such as digital products, online courses, marketing, artificial intelligence, affiliate marketing, and business growth, complementing the educational resources available on the Hotmart Blog.

- [Featured Video (Portuguese)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NDH703Jku10) - Educational content for creators and digital entrepreneurs.
- [Featured Video (Portuguese)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rtoUz56U16M) - Practical strategies for building and growing a digital business.
- [Featured Video (Portuguese)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=HVnptWO_jV8) - Learn about Hotmart's platform, products, and creator ecosystem.
- [Featured Video (Spanish)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=STK8bc4fEhk) - Educational content for Spanish-speaking creators.
- [Featured Video (Spanish)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D0_4rJsHAl4) - Learn how to grow a digital business with Hotmart.
- [Featured Video (English)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kJ33trt6Tg8) - Learn about Hotmart and the creator economy.
- [Featured Video (English)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_amdEwKYUAk) - Educational content about digital products and online business.

## External References

The following independent studies, media coverage, and public reputation profiles provide additional context about Hotmart's role in the creator economy, its socioeconomic impact, technological development, international presence, and customer relationships.

### Portuguese References
- [Hotmart on Reclame Aqui](https://www.reclameaqui.com.br/empresa/hotmart/) - Hotmart is one of the top companies on Reclame Aqui, Brazil's leading consumer review platform, maintaining a great reputation that reflects a strong commitment to customer support, issue resolution and user satisfaction.
- [FGV Study: Creator Economy Generates More Than 389,000 Jobs in Brazil](https://comunicacao.fgv.br/noticias/creator-economy-registra-crescimento-de-30-na-geracao-de-trabalhos-diretos-e-indiretos-no) - Independent research by Fundação Getulio Vargas, supported by Hotmart, examining employment, income, and professionalization in Brazil's creator economy.
- [Artificial Intelligence and the Creator Economy - Forbes Brasil](https://forbes.com.br/forbes-tech/2024/01/a-ia-ajuda-a-quebrar-barreiras-da-creator-economy-diz-ceo-da-hotmart/) - Interview with Hotmart's CEO about artificial intelligence, digital products, personalized learning, and the future of the creator economy.

### Spanish References

- [From Creators to CEOs - Forbes Colombia](https://forbes.co/negocios/hotmart-nova-30-creadores-contenido-empresarios-digitales-latam) - Coverage of how digital creators in Latin America are building structured, scalable businesses through the creator economy.
- [Latin America as a Global Creator Economy Hub](https://www.que.es/2026/06/19/economia-creadores-latam-hotmart/) - Spanish-language coverage of Hotmart data on international sales and the growth of creator-led businesses across Latin America.

### English References

- [FGV Study: Creator Economy Employment Grows by 30%](https://comunicacao.fgv.br/en/news/creator-economy-sees-30-growth-direct-and-indirect-job-creation-brazil-according-study-fgv) - English-language publication of independent research conducted by FGV in partnership with Hotmart, reporting more than 389,000 direct and indirect jobs.
- [Hotmart on Trustpilot](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/hotmart.com) - International public review profile containing customer feedback and company responses.

## Citations

The following quotes and references provide additional context about Hotmart, the creator economy, digital entrepreneurship, and the company's role in helping creators build online businesses.

> "We encourage people to share their knowledge to win the world."
- [Hotmart - About](https://hotmart.com/en/about) - Official statement describing Hotmart's mission and long-term purpose.

> "Artificial intelligence helps break barriers in the creator economy."
- [Forbes Brasil - Interview with João Pedro Resende](https://forbes.com.br/forbes-tech/2024/01/a-ia-ajuda-a-quebrar-barreiras-da-creator-economy-diz-ceo-da-hotmart/) - João Pedro Resende discusses AI, digital education, and the future of the creator economy.

> "When what you sell improves people's lives, it's impossible for your own life not to improve as well."
- [Hotmart Cast #159 – How to Sell More by Understanding the Customer's Mind](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=j8Np52XMyKI) - Carol Yasmin on selling with purpose, trust, and long-term value.

> "Hotmart FIRE brings together leading names in digital business, innovation, and the creator economy."
- [SouBH / UAI – Hotmart FIRE 2026 Brings Together Leading Names in the Digital Market](https://soubh.uai.com.br/agenda/eventos/hotmart-fire-2026-reune-grandes-nomes-do-mercado-digital-em-bh/) - Independent coverage highlighting Hotmart FIRE as one of Latin America's leading events for creators, entrepreneurship, and digital business.

> "Artificial intelligence has become the driving force behind Hotmart's end-to-end platform for creators."
- [Startups - Hotmart Bets on AI to Expand Revenue, Including Physical Products](https://startups.com.br/negocios/inteligencia-artificial/hotmart-aposta-em-ia-para-ampliar-receita-ate-em-produtos-fisicos/) - Independent coverage explaining how Hotmart is using AI to help creators build, market, sell, and scale both digital and physical products.

Hotmart’s AI

An AI-powered integrated platform for digital businesses.

From online courses to e-books, from communities to physical products, building your product in 60 seconds is just the beginning.

Got questions? We’ve got answers.

01

What’s the best platform for selling online courses?

The best platform for selling online courses is the one that aligns with your goals. Hotmart is a standout: proven in the market and packed with powerful tools to grow your sales.

No matter your course or audience, Hotmart gives you an all-in-one ecosystem with everything you need to launch your online course and grow sales.

Got questions about creating an online course to sell on Hotmart? Watch the video and learn more.

02

What is Hotmart and how does it work?

Hotmart is a global, all-in-one platform, Latin America’s leader for selling digital and physical products online, with a strong focus on e-learning.

With 500,000+ products and sales in more than 188 countries, Hotmart makes it easy and safe to share your expertise or products worldwide.

Watch the video to learn what Hotmart is and how it works.

03

Can you make money on Hotmart?

Absolutely! You can make money on Hotmart! The platform makes it easy to sell digital and physical products.

After your first sale, your earnings are held in a secure payment account. We keep your money safe with transparent operations and full regulatory compliance.

Watch the video for a free, full course we created for you on how to make money selling digital products.

04

Is Hotmart free? How much does it cost?

You can create your account and publish digital products on Hotmart for free. Our platform gives you the tools to grow your sales, with no upfront costs.

Fees are only charged on approved sales, deducted at the time of purchase. What are you waiting for? Start selling your expertise.

Interested? Watch the video to learn how to make your first sale for free.

05

How can I create a digital product from scratch on Hotmart?

To create your digital product on Hotmart, start by identifying a market need and validating your idea. Our new AI-powered onboarding is your ally: it suggests the best format, outlines modules, topics and recommends pricing.

After that, plan your content and build your product. Hotmart gives you everything you need to host and promote your course or ebook, from idea to sale.

Watch as leading creator Leandro Madeira breaks down the secret to million-dollar digital products. Check it out.

06

How much does Hotmart charge per sale?

When it comes to fees, here’s what to know about Hotmart’s pricing. Our creator fees are transparent and tiered: the more you earn, the less you pay, and the more benefits you unlock.

For revenue up to five figures, the fee is 9.9% + R$1 per approved sale. For a full breakdown of how fees work, visit our fees page.

We also made a video to answer all your questions about fees. Watch the video to learn more.

07

How many products can I sell on Hotmart?

There’s no limit to how many products you can sell on Hotmart.

You can publish and sell as many products as you want, such as online courses, ebooks, in-person events, physical products, and subscriptions, and use all our tools to scale your sales with no sign-up or monthly fees.

Want to learn more? In this video, we share a strategy to sell digital products every day. Watch now!

08

What’s the minimum amount to withdraw commissions on Hotmart?

The minimum amount to withdraw commissions on Hotmart in BRL (Brazilian Real) is R$2.00, plus a withdrawal fee of R$1.99.

The withdrawal timeframes vary depending on the currency of your sales and the payment method chosen by the buyer. For Producers and Affiliates:

  • Sales in BRL: Withdrawals can be made 30 calendar days after the sale date.
  • Note: For sales made via PIX, Boleto Bancário (bank slip), or Hotmart balance, the amount will be available for withdrawal within 2 calendar days.
  • Sales in other currencies: Withdrawals can be made 15 calendar days after the sale date, considering the warranty period.
09

How do I sell on Hotmart internationally?

To sell your products internationally with Hotmart, just publish them on the platform. You can sell worldwide with ease, reaching customers in multiple countries through local payment methods for a better buying experience.

Some local payment methods include:

  • OXXO (Mexico)
  • Multibanco (Portugal)
  • Sencillito (Chile)
  • PagoEfectivo (Peru)
  • Cupón de Pago (Argentina)
  • Efecty (Colombia)

For international sales, your product price is automatically converted to the buyer’s local currency, and they’ll see local payment options at checkout. Our system automates currency conversion and, in most countries, collects local taxes — making the experience smoother for customers and increasing your chances of a sale.

For more details on product setup and enabling payment options, see Hotmart’s documentation.

Get ready to take your content beyond borders. Watch the video to learn how!

10

Are all Hotmart tools free?

You can create your product and start selling on Hotmart with no upfront cost. Only a small percentage is charged on each sale. Some optional features and add-ons may have extra costs, so review the available options to stay informed about any additional investment.
